findings.message: ".cursor-ring" has CSS `transform: translate(-15px,-15px)` and a GSAP tween animates x/y/scale. GSAP will overwrite the full CSS transform, discarding any translateX(-50%) centering or CSS scale value.
findings.fixHint: Remove `transform: translate(-15px,-15px)` from CSS and replace with GSAP properties: x: -15, y: -15. Example: tl.fromTo('.cursor-ring', { x: -15, y: -15 }, { x: -15, y: -15, ...yourAnimation }). tl.fromTo is exempt from this rule.

findings.message: ".source-two" has CSS `transform: translateX(-8px)` and a GSAP tween animates x. GSAP will overwrite the full CSS transform, discarding any translateX(-50%) centering or CSS scale value.
findings.fixHint: Remove `transform: translateX(-8px)` from CSS and replace with GSAP properties: x: -8. Example: tl.fromTo('.source-two', { x: -8 }, { x: -8, ...yourAnimation }). tl.fromTo is exempt from this rule.

findings.message: GSAP tween on ".surface" uses motion that snaps to integer device pixels: top. Layout and text-reflow properties snap during browser layout; roundProps rounds the tween value. Slow motion or an ease-out tail then stutters under the seek-by-frame capture engine. Animate transforms (x/y/scale/opacity) instead.
findings.fixHint: replace top with the transform equivalent (y), e.g. tl.fromTo(".surface", { x: -1300 }, { x: 0, ...yourAnimation }). Transforms interpolate sub-pixel and stay smooth at any speed.

findings.message: Font family used without @font-face declaration: sfmono-regular. These are not in the auto-resolved font list, so the renderer cannot supply them automatically. Text will fall back to a generic font, producing incorrect typography in the video.
findings.fixHint: Add @font-face { font-family: '...'; src: url('capture/assets/fonts/...woff2'); } for each font family, pointing to the captured .woff2 files. For an OS-bundled system font (e.g. Hiragino Sans, Microsoft YaHei) that has no downloadable file, use src: local('Exact Font Name') instead. The declaration alone satisfies this check without needing a font file.

findings.message: <section> is a timeline element that contains nested <div>. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <section> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.
